text:
deploy-bot: kicking off config-only rollout r-c12b. change-window 10:05-10:35 UTC. Canary: 4% for 8m. Diff (config-only): rate_limiter.max_per_min: 10000 -> 8000, request_timeout_ms: 25000 -> 22000, routing.policy: weighted -> latency-aware, batch_window_ms: 70 -> 55. no model changes.
leo: ack. who owns dashboards for this window?
priya: i'll watch p50/p95/p99, 5xx_rate, and kvcache_miss. watching 10:07-10:20. :mag:
ops-sre: pager rule set: 5xx > 0.7% sustained 60s. i'll be onshift.
jun: note from perf lab: switching to latency-aware routing can cause churn for multi-region tenants; recommend per-tenant pin playbook ready.
nora: added rollback snippet to rollout notes: auto-rollback if p99_latency_ms > 600ms for 120s OR 5xx_rate_pct > 0.7 for 60s. also add kvcache rule: if kvcache_miss_pct increases by >8% absolute for 3m, revert batch_window. snippet:
```
{"rollback_conditions":[{"metric":"p99_latency_ms","threshold":600,"duration_s":120},{"metric":"5xx_rate_pct","threshold":0.7,"duration_s":60},{"metric":"kvcache_miss_pct_delta","threshold":8,"duration_s":180}]}
```
leo: good. also add tenant-pin quick command for ops in notes (ops to run if a tenant spikes):
```
curl -XPOST "https://admin.internal/tenants/pin" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" -d '{"tenant":"T-42","route":"route-stable","duration":"30m"}'
```
priya: i'll keep special watch on T-42 and T-314 — both had issues when batch_window was tightened last month.
ops-sre: ready to pin. will DM confirmation once executed. pager escalation if auto-rollback fires.
deploy-bot: Canary rolled to 4% at 1791230065. initial metrics at +90s: p50=105ms p95=215ms p99=420ms 5xx=0.04% kvcache_miss=3.2%. no triggers.
jun: saw a short p99 spike to ~650ms at 10:10 for ~30s, traced to a tenant T-314 burst; isolated.
leo: since that's above p99 threshold, recommendation: pin T-314 for 30m and hold canary. ops-sre, you ok to run pin?
ops-sre: executing pin for T-314 now. curl ran and returned 200. notifying.
priya: metrics after pin: p99 back to 430ms, p95 stable. kvcache_miss rose slightly to 4.1% but within threshold.
nora: because this was a single-tenant tail, we'll avoid full rollback. update rollout notes: tenant-pin applied, continuing hold.
deploy-bot: holding at 4% canary 30s elapsed. latest summary: p50=100ms p95=205ms p99=430ms 5xx=0.03% kvcache_miss=4.1%. no auto-rollback. planned manual ramp: if stable for remaining 6m, manual ramp to 20% for 10m then full promotion.
leo: concur. keep the tenant-pin playbook handy; if T-42 or any other tenant repeats, pin and reassess.
priya: i'll paste final diff and rollback JSON into the release doc and include the exact commands we used. :memo:
deploy-bot: canary hold complete at 1791230480. awaiting manual decision to ramp to 20%.
